name: Non-resident converts documented onshore income and wires USD out
name_zh: 境外个人经常项目合法人民币收入购汇 + 汇出
ceiling: No annual quota for 境外个人 (S03, S43); bank evidence review applies
verdict: Cheapest and fastest lawful route when the RMB is traceable to taxed income

name: Resident uses the USD 50,000 annual convenience amount, year after year
name_zh: 境内个人年度便利化额度内购汇汇出
ceiling: USD 50,000 per person per year on an ID document alone
verdict: Lawful but slow: USD 400,000 needs 8 calendar years

name: Emigrant property transfer (whole estate, one application)
ceiling: No statutory ceiling; up to RMB 500,000 decided locally, above that by SAFE head office
verdict: No amount ceiling, but staged over two years and it needs a cancelled hukou

name: Inheritance transfer
ceiling: No statutory ceiling; same RMB 500,000 local / head-office split as M03
verdict: The right route if the money arrived by inheritance rather than as your own savings

name: Non-resident remits the proceeds of selling China property
name_zh: 境外个人出售境内商品房所得购汇汇出
ceiling: No ceiling stated in the rule; self-use test applies
verdict: Lawful for sale proceeds; the 20% PRC tax on the gain is the real cost, not the conversion

name: Re-convert unused RMB against the original exchange memo
name_zh: 原兑换未用完的人民币兑回
ceiling: Limited to the original amount exchanged; memo valid 24 months
verdict: Free of the quota problem but only if you personally brought the FX in

name: Wire out foreign currency already sitting in your FX account
name_zh: 境外个人外汇储蓄账户汇出境外
ceiling: No amount limit stated for account transfers
verdict: If part of the balance is already USD, transfer that first: no spread to pay

family: Lawful — but capped far below the target
name: Withdraw USD cash abroad on your Chinese bank card
ceiling: RMB 100,000 equivalent per natural year across all your cards; RMB 10,000 per card per day
verdict: Costs more than it saves: 6 calendar years for USD 400,000, and the per-withdrawal fee is unpublished

family: Lawful — but capped far below the target
name: Carry cash out by hand
ceiling: ≤ USD 5,000 no permit; USD 5,000–10,000 needs a 携带证; above USD 10,000 not in principle
verdict: No bank fee, but 40 trips for USD 400,000 and physical-loss risk

name: Move RMB to Hong Kong and convert offshore at the CNH rate
name_zh: 跨境人民币汇出后离岸兑换
ceiling: Individual cross-border RMB remittance is subject to the same current-account evidence rules; no open personal channel
verdict: Possible in principle, but no official source prices a personal offshore conversion, so the cost is blank

family: Not available to you as described
name: QDII fund quota
ceiling: Institutional quota; the individual buys a fund, not a currency
verdict: A retail investment product, not a currency-conversion tool; eligibility unverified

family: Not available to you as described
name: Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect
ceiling: Residents of the nine Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao GBA cities; quota per investor
verdict: Closed to a US citizen who is not a GBA resident; eligibility unverified

name: Spend the RMB abroad on a UnionPay card instead of converting it
ceiling: Card limits; spending abroad does not consume the FX convenience amount
verdict: Avoids conversion entirely but produces goods, not USD

name: Leave the balance in CNY and let it pass to heirs
ceiling: None
verdict: Zero cost now; the FX and reporting questions simply move to your estate

name: Split the balance across relatives' USD 50,000 quotas
ceiling: Not permitted at all
verdict: Penalty exposure 30%–100% of the amount plus a spot on the watch list

name: Underground bank / matched orders (对敲)
ceiling: Not permitted at all
verdict: Art. 45 applies: up to 100% fine, plus criminal liability above the threshold

name: Buy USDT or another stablecoin and sell it abroad
ceiling: Prohibited
verdict: Illegal financial activity since 2021 and still illegal under the 2026 notice

name: Manufacture trade or service documents to buy FX
ceiling: Not permitted at all
verdict: Art. 40: 30%–100% of the amount, funds returned, criminal referral possible

name: Route it through a US relative as a 'gift' to dodge the FX rules
ceiling: Depends on facts; a genuine gift from a foreign person is lawful
verdict: Only lawful if it is a real gift of the relative's own money; otherwise art. 39

family: Lawful — only if you own the company
name: Take a dividend from your own PRC company, then remit it
name_zh: 外商投资企业利润汇出
ceiling: No ceiling; tax and audit clearance required
verdict: Same banking cost as M01, plus PRC dividend withholding and audit work
